---
title: "RESPOND v1 vs v2 Benchmark Comparison"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

## Inputs

```{r}
combined_path <- "data/combined_runtime.csv"
if (!file.exists(combined_path)) {
    stop(
        "Missing data/combined_runtime.csv. Run scripts/prepare_benchmark_data.R after generating v1 and v2 runtime CSVs."
    )
}

runtime <- read_csv(combined_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("v1", "v2")))

required_models <- c("v1", "v2")
present_models <- unique(as.character(runtime$model))
if (!all(required_models %in% present_models)) {
    stop("Combined runtime file must include both models: v1 and v2.")
}
```

## Summary Table (Direct v1 vs v2)

```{r}
summary_tbl <- runtime |>
    group_by(model) |>
    summarise(
        mean_of_means_ms = mean(mean_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_of_means_ms = median(mean_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_p95_ms = mean(p95_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_std_ms = mean(std_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_sample_sizes = n_distinct(sample_size),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(model)

kable(summary_tbl, digits = 3)
```

```{r}
compare_tbl <- runtime |>
    select(model, sample_size, mean_ms, p95_ms, std_ms) |>
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = model,
        values_from = c(mean_ms, p95_ms, std_ms),
        names_glue = "{.value}_{model}"
    ) |>
    mutate(
        mean_speedup_v1_over_v2 = mean_ms_v1 / mean_ms_v2,
        p95_speedup_v1_over_v2 = p95_ms_v1 / p95_ms_v2
    ) |>
    arrange(sample_size)

kable(compare_tbl, digits = 3)
```

## Runtime Over Sample Size

```{r}
ggplot(runtime, aes(x = sample_size, y = mean_ms, color = model)) +
    W
geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(runtime$sample_size))) +
    labs(
        title = "Runtime vs Sample Size",
        x = "Sample Size",
        y = "Mean Runtime (ms)",
        color = "Model"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
